title: 第21章 我不介意连你一块打第22章 神秘皇后极阴之体
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
额？
一道冰冷刺骨的视线，宛如毒蛇般死死地钉在楚风身上，其中蕴含的杀意几乎凝为实质。
楚风眉头一挑，顺着感觉望去，正对上太平公主那双几欲喷火的眼眸。
他神色一滞，自己什么时候得罪过这位公主了？
很快记忆如潮水般涌来，一幕不堪回首的画面在脑海中浮现。
几个月前，皇宫夜宴，原身喝得酩酊大醉，竟当着众人的面，一把抱住这位太平公主，强行吻了下去。
非礼公主，这在任何一个皇朝都是足以抄家灭族的重罪！
当时镇北王府权势滔天，原身父亲和两位叔叔手握重兵，威震朝野。
饶是如此，镇北王也气得当场把原身抽了个半死。
最终，乾皇也只是高高举起，轻轻落下，训斥一番，让其赔礼道歉了事。
可这位太平公主却不依不饶，当场拔剑要杀了楚风，最后被乾皇强行拦下，还被禁足思过。
自己被轻薄，反倒成了被惩罚的那个。
这口恶气，她如何能咽得下？
难怪一见面就恨不得将自己生吞活剥。
明白前因后果，楚风心中不禁暗骂，自己这前身还真是个彻头彻尾的混账，而且品味独特，连这种‘飞机场’都下得去嘴，是没见过女人么？
“你这个无耻混蛋……”
陆璃指着楚风，气得浑身发抖，眼看就要破口大骂。
“小妹，不得无礼，快入座！”
陆元见状，连忙出声制止，生怕她搅了宴会。
“哼！”

陆璃重重地哼了一声，狠狠剜了楚风一眼，这才转身落座，但那双眼睛，依旧如刀子般一下下刮在楚风身上，像一头随时准备扑上来撕咬的母老虎。
“你和这位公主，又有什么恩怨？”
萧霓凰在楚风身边坐下，声音清冷，不带一丝温度。
“咳，一点小误会。”
楚风尴尬地摸了摸鼻子，这话说出来，他自己都不信。
众人纷纷落座，宴会眼看就要开始。
就在这时，一道身影径直朝着楚风走了过来，正是四皇子陆凌。
他一动，殿内所有人的目光瞬间被吸引了过去。
陆凌在楚风面前站定，居高临下，开门见山：“前几日，你打了本皇子的人。”
楚风眼皮都懒得抬一下，吐道：“你说那个姓李的软脚虾？没错，我打的，有意见？”
唰！
陆凌的脸色瞬间阴沉下来，眼中寒芒闪烁：“打狗还得看主人，你动本皇子的人，想过后果么？”
“后果？”
楚风嘴角微微上扬，吐出的话却让整个大殿的空气都为之一凝。
“不知道，不过……我不介意连你一块打！”
content_en:
Forehead?
A cold and piercing sight was like a poisonous snake, nailing Chu Feng's body, and the murderous intention contained in it almost condensed into substance.
Chu Feng raised his brows and looked along the way, meeting Princess Taiping's eyes that were almost burning.
His expression froze. When had he ever offended this princess?
Soon memories came flooding back, and an unforgettable scene emerged in my mind.
A few months ago, during a night banquet in the palace, I was so drunk that I hugged Princess Taiping and kissed her forcefully in front of everyone.
Indecent assault on a princess is a serious crime in any dynasty that can destroy the entire family!
At that time, the power of the Prince of Zhenbei was overwhelming, and his father and two uncles held heavy troops and were powerful in both the government and the public.
Even so, King Zhenbei was so angry that he whipped the original body half to death on the spot.
In the end, Qianhuang just raised it high, lowered it gently, scolded him, and asked him to apologize.
But Princess Taiping refused to give in. She drew her sword on the spot and wanted to kill Chu Feng. In the end, she was forcibly stopped by Emperor Qian and was even restrained to think about her mistakes.
Being treated lightly, he became the one being punished.
How could she swallow this bad breath?
No wonder they wanted to eat him alive as soon as they met.
After understanding the cause and effect, Chu Feng couldn't help but curse in his heart. His predecessor was really a complete bastard, and he had unique taste. He could even talk about this kind of "airport". Has he never seen a woman before?
"You shameless bastard..."
Lu Li pointed at Chu Feng, trembling with anger and about to curse.
"Little sister, please don't be rude, please take a seat!"
When Lu Yuan saw this, he quickly stopped her, fearing that she would disturb the banquet.
"Hmph!"
Lu Li snorted heavily and gave Chu Feng a fierce look before turning around and sitting down, but those eyes were still swiping at Chu Feng like knives, like a tigress ready to pounce and bite him at any time.
"What grudges do you have with this princess?"
Xiao Nihuang sat down next to Chu Feng, her voice was cold and without any warmth.
"Ahem, a little misunderstanding."
Chu Feng touched his nose in embarrassment. Even when he said this, he didn't believe it himself.
Everyone took their seats and the banquet was about to begin.
At this moment, a figure walked straight towards Chu Feng, it was the fourth prince Lu Ling.
As soon as he moved, the eyes of everyone in the hall were instantly attracted.
Lu Ling stood still in front of Chu Feng, condescending and straight to the point: "A few days ago, you beat one of my prince's men."
Chu Feng didn't even bother to raise his eyelids and said, "You mean that soft-footed shrimp named Li? Yes, I beat him. Do you have any objections?"
Uh-huh!
Lu Ling's face instantly darkened, and a cold light flashed in his eyes: "It depends on the owner to beat a dog. If you touch this prince's people, have you thought about the consequences?"
"Consequences?"
The corners of Chu Feng's mouth raised slightly, but the words he spat out made the air in the entire hall freeze.
"I don't know, but...I don't mind beating you too!"
